SuraLink terms of use

Updated November 22, 2026

These terms describe use of the SuraLink Android app and its learning service.

Learning and accounts

SuraLink provides guided Quran learning and prayer practice. Guided explanations are distinct from Quran text and are educational material. Keep your sign-in details secure. Do not misuse the service, access another person’s account or redistribute third-party content without permission.

Free and paid features

Free features and optional Unlimited benefits are described in the app. Google Play displays subscription pricing, billing duration and applicable offers before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through Google Play. Refunds and billing support follow the applicable store process and your statutory rights. Deleting the app or your SuraLink account does not cancel a subscription.

Availability and your learning

Audio, cloud backup and other connected tools need network access. Speech recognition, live compass direction and permissions vary by device. Manual city selection and typed recall are available alternatives. Keep an exported learning backup if you need an additional copy.

Privacy and deletion

See the privacy policy for data handling and account deletion instructions. Contact zaine.raja@gmail.com for support or questions about these terms.
